description: Only actions the builder does not model, every one a generic block: unmodeled Types, and two forms of modeled Types that their classes do not write (tasks/D04), CompleteOutboundCall carrying VoiceConnector (owner decision 4) and StartOutboundChatContact in the WhatsApp form with InitialTemplatedSystemMessage, a key the catalog lacks (conformance/hcl/README.md, rule 10). Parameters are jsonencode with the reference tokens escaped, and one action with no parameters carries only its type.
